newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR rates decline across the board.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR rates decline across the board.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) nudged down across the board on Thursday after the two percentage-point cut in the Central Bank's overnight borrowing rate to 18 percent, traders said.
"We're anticipating lower rates," a dealer said.
Central Bank governor Gabriel Singson earlier told Reuters in Hong Kong overnight rates could return to normal levels next week as soon as market conditions stabilise.
The Central Bank had raised its key rate last week to defend the peso from speculation arising from the Thai baht's problems.
